title: First and Last Element Sum
question: Given an array of integers, return the sum of the first and last elements.
human_reason: Performs direct array index access and one addition; independent of array length N.

title: Bitwise Parity Check
question: Determine whether an integer N is even or odd using bitwise AND.
human_reason: Single bitwise AND operation on a 32-bit integer takes constant O(1) time and space.

title: Arithmetic Series Sum Formula
question: Calculate the sum of natural numbers from 1 to N using Gauss' formula.
human_reason: Calculates closed-form mathematical formula with one multiplication and division; O(1) time.

title: Matrix Center Coordinate Lookup
question: Return the center element of an N x N 2D array assuming N is odd.
human_reason: Single 2D array dereference at computed midpoint indices; runs in constant O(1) time.

title: Classic Binary Search
question: Find the index of target in a sorted integer array using binary search.
human_reason: Halves the active search interval at every iteration of the while-loop; O(log N) time and O(1) memory.

title: Integer Square Root via Binary Search
question: Compute the floor integer square root of N.
human_reason: Binary searches the domain [1, x/2], cutting search space by half each step; O(log N) time.

title: Repeated Division Power of Two Check
question: Count how many times N can be divided by 2 before reaching 1.
human_reason: Divides input variable N by 2 on every loop iteration, executing exactly floor(log2(N)) times.

title: Recursive Binary Search with Helper
question: Recursively locate target in sorted array.
human_reason: Recursive binary partition yields recursion depth of log2(N), taking O(log N) time and O(log N) call stack space.

title: Array Maximum Finder
question: Find the maximum integer in an unsorted array.
human_reason: Single sequential traversal scanning all N elements once; O(N) time and O(1) space.

title: Two-Pointer String Palindrome Verification
question: Check if a string is palindrome using two converging pointers.
human_reason: Pointers meet at N/2 iterations, inspecting each character at most once; O(N) time and O(1) space.

title: Frequency Map using HashMap
question: Count frequency of numbers in an array using HashMap.
human_reason: N hash table insertions with O(1) average lookup; O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.

title: Java Stream Filter and Sum
question: Filter positive numbers and sum them using Java Stream API.
human_reason: Stream pipeline performs one terminal fold over N elements in linear O(N) time.

title: Linear Recursive Array Sum
question: Recursively compute sum of array elements.
human_reason: N recursive frames on call stack visiting each index once; O(N) time and O(N) stack space.

title: Sorting Followed by Two-Pointer Target Search
question: Sort array and find pair with target sum.
human_reason: Dual-pivot Quicksort (O(N log N)) dominates the linear O(N) two-pointer pass; overall O(N log N).

title: Merge Sort Divide and Conquer
question: Classic Merge Sort implementation.
human_reason: Recursion tree depth is log2(N) with linear O(N) merge at each level; O(N log N) time and O(N) space.

title: PriorityQueue Top-K Frequent Heap
question: Insert N elements into a min-heap to find largest elements.
human_reason: N heap insertions with logarithmic sift-up/down operations take O(N log N) time.

title: Interval Sorting and Overlap Merging
question: Sort intervals by start time and merge overlaps.
human_reason: Sorting array of N intervals dominates with O(N log N) time; linear sweep takes O(N).

title: All Pairs Nested For-Loops
question: Count pairs that sum to target using brute force.
human_reason: Evaluates N*(N-1)/2 element pairs across two nested loops; quadratic O(N^2) time and O(1) space.

title: Selection Sort Brute Force
question: In-place Selection Sort implementation.
human_reason: Inner loop scans remaining subarray for minimum on every outer iteration; O(N^2) comparisons.

title: Nested While-Loops Comparison
question: Find duplicates using nested while loops.
human_reason: Nested while loops compare each pair of elements; O(N^2) iterations with O(1) space.

title: Loop with Linear Helper Method
question: For each element, check if its negation exists in array.
human_reason: Outer loop iterates N times, invoking linear O(N) helper on each iteration; O(N^2) total time.

title: 2D Matrix Diagonal Sweep
question: Traverse all cells of an N x N matrix.
human_reason: Visits all N^2 cells in an N x N matrix; O(N^2) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

title: Three Sum Brute Force
question: Find all unique triplets that sum to 0 using triple nested loops.
human_reason: Three nested loops iterate across N*(N-1)*(N-2)/6 triplet combinations; O(N^3) time.

title: Square Matrix Multiplication
question: Multiply two N x N matrices using definition.
human_reason: Three nested loops each iterating N times perform N^3 scalar multiplications; O(N^3) time.

title: Triple While-Loops 3D Coordinate Grid Sweep
question: Traverse 3D grid with dimensions N x N x N using while loops.
human_reason: Three nested while loops executing N steps each produce N^3 loop body evaluations; O(N^3) time.

title: Double Loop with Linear Search Helper
question: For all pairs (i, j), search linearly in array for their product.
human_reason: Double loop iterates N^2 times, invoking linear O(N) search helper on each step; O(N^3) overall.

title: Recursive Fibonacci without Memoization
question: Compute the N-th Fibonacci number using naive recursion.
human_reason: Binary branching recursive tree of depth N generates ~2^N total function calls with O(N) call stack.

title: Recursive Power Set Subsets Generation
question: Generate all 2^N subsets of an array recursively.
human_reason: Generates exactly 2^N subsets via binary branching decisions (include/exclude) at each of the N elements.

title: Recursive 0/1 Knapsack without Memoization
question: Solve 0/1 knapsack using brute force recursion.
human_reason: Unmemoized recursive branching evaluates both include and exclude branches for N items; O(2^N) time.

title: Recursive Combination Sum with Binary Choices
question: Count combination pathways to target without DP.
human_reason: Binary recursive tree splits into two calls at each step down to base case; exponential O(2^N) time.
